name: late_gas_flow_step
description: The deferred scenario D — a sudden excursion rather than a drift — placed deliberately late. One etch chamber's delivered gas flow steps off its setpoint at day 63 and stays there: no ramp, no warning, three weeks of record afterwards and nine before. This is scenario C's mechanism under `profile: step`, which the mechanism library has supported since day one, so it costs a configuration and no code. Two things it measures that the Phase 1 five cannot. A late fault leaves a short post-onset segment, which is where a change-point contrast has least to work with and where a mid-horizon anchor is simply in the wrong place; and a step at `obvious` is the easiest shape this library contains, so if the engine cannot find this one, the difficulty is not the fault.
